name: costas_livre_v2
prompt: Precise object edit of the supplied 3x3 transparent animation sprite sheet. Keep the exact same 9-cell layout, dimensions, original waiter identity, warm soft3D render style, color palette, camera view and facing direction, and true transparent background. Preserve every head, torso, waistcoat, shirt, arm and tray (if present) in its existing location and scale. Change ONLY the legs and feet in WALKING cells1 through8, to repair foot contact in this WALK cycle. At least ONE shoe must be visibly planted flat on the SAME invisible ground plane in EVERY frame; no airborne frames, no hopping, no running, no skipping. In particular cells3 and4 currently bend BOTH knees and lift BOTH feet: repair these with the STANCE leg extended naturally down to the ground and only the other SWING leg bent and advancing. Keep hips at their existing height. Left stance/right swing alternate smoothly across the eight distinct phases. Legs must remain adult human proportions, full trousers/shoes intact. Use idle cell9's lowest soles as the common ground contact baseline relative to each cell (approximately91%cellheight) for the supporting foot. The contact can vary horizontally with the stride, never float vertically. Cell9 standing idle must stay unchanged. This is for an in-place natural WALK, each image shows the SAME stationary person at a different phase, not jumping. No additional objects, text, shadow, outlines or background. Preserve clean native alpha. Keep all sprites within their original cells, 3 columns3rows, exactly9 instances. Do not change the view to the front or mirror the sheet.
